description: Random pixel dropout plus thick border cut-outs (4–24 px), like after a fast head turn. The net learns to regenerate.

status.comment: train.dropout implemented (119fc0f, training rollouts only since d9807ed); border regeneration via head-turn augmentation (ddb3c27f). Clean result, evaluate.py 64 rollouts x 96 frames without dropout (runs/*/eval96.txt): nodrop: net vs push-pull -18.9% all pixels, +12.1% holes; drop30: -21.0% all, +11.2% holes. Dropout 0.3 gives no gain on holes and is slightly worse overall; keep train.dropout = 0 by default.
